cat > /tmp/answers_calc.py << 'EOF'
import json, sys
from collections import Counter

path = sys.argv[1]
rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(path) if l.strip()]

def g(r, k):
    v = r.get(k, 0)
    return v

# Q2: number of rows
q2 = len(rows)

# Q3: distinct label values
labels = [r.get("label") for r in rows]
q3 = len(set(labels))

# Q1: decode_tok_s of specific row
row1 = next((r for r in rows if r.get("label")=="heretic-sly-cr10000" and r.get("rep")==0 and r.get("stream")==0 and r.get("source")=="2026-10-30-0806-engine-heretic-sly-cr10000"), None)
q1 = row1.get("decode_tok_s") if row1 else "none"

# Q4: label with single highest decode_tok_s (only consider rows where field present)
with_dts = [r for r in rows if r.get("decode_tok_s") is not None]
top = max(with_dts, key=lambda r: r["decode_tok_s"])
q4 = top.get("label")

# Q5: lowest prefill_tok_s (only present)
with_pt = [r for r in rows if r.get("prefill_tok_s") is not None]
q5 = min(r["prefill_tok_s"] for r in with_pt)

# Q6: count label muse-vulkan-d32768
q6 = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("label")=="muse-vulkan-d32768")

# Q7: mean decode_tok_s of label dx-cr40000 to 2 decimals (missing treated as 0)
dx = [r.get("decode_tok_s", 0) for r in rows if r.get("label")=="dx-cr40000"]
q7 = round(sum(dx)/len(dx), 2) if dx else "none"

# Q8: sum of prompt_tokens label pf-cr64000 (missing as 0)
pf = [r.get("prompt_tokens", 0) for r in rows if r.get("label")=="pf-cr64000"]
q8 = sum(pf)

# Q9: count decode_tok_s below 20 (present only)
q9 = sum(1 for r in with_dts if r["decode_tok_s"] < 20)

# Q10: count concurrency above 1
q10 = sum(1 for r in rows if r.get("concurrency",0) > 1)

print("Q1", q1)
print("Q2", q2)
print("Q3", q3)
print("Q4", q4)
print("Q5", q5)
print("Q6", q6)
print("Q7", q7)
print("Q8", q8)
print("Q9", q9)
print("Q10", q10)

# debug: show candidate Q1 rows
print("DEBUG_Q1_matches:", [ (r.get("rep"),r.get("stream"),r.get("source")) for r in rows if r.get("label")=="heretic-sly-cr10000" ])
EOF
